outcomes.meaning: Every required premise and constraint is satisfied for the exact rule/version and task scope.
outcomes.completion_effect: A derived candidate may be created with complete provenance; it is not verified truth.

outcomes.meaning: The input is sufficiently known and valid, but one or more required premises or constraints do not match.
outcomes.completion_effect: The task may still be complete; absence of a match is not negation.

outcomes.meaning: A required semantic value or premise explicitly carries UNKNOWN and cannot be evaluated.
outcomes.completion_effect: Preserve the UNKNOWN source status and diagnostic; do not coerce it to false or unresolved.

outcomes.meaning: A required identity, typed reference, definition version, or scope binding is missing or cannot be resolved.
outcomes.completion_effect: Preserve the unresolved reference and its location; do not invent a binding.

outcomes.meaning: More than one materially distinct binding or exact definition candidate satisfies the incomplete pattern.
outcomes.completion_effect: Preserve all candidates and the ambiguity group; do not select by label, score, or order.

outcomes.meaning: Relevant premises or assertions disagree under the exact comparison scope, or an input is explicitly DISPUTED.
outcomes.completion_effect: Preserve all conflicting items; no winner is selected and no dependent rule is applied.

outcomes.meaning: The constructor, rule, rule version, mapping, or operation is outside the explicitly enabled subset.
outcomes.completion_effect: Preserve the original structure and report unsupported status.

outcomes.meaning: The input violates USG-SEM/1.0 schema, typed-reference integrity, or a mandatory structural invariant.
outcomes.completion_effect: Reject rule processing for the invalid input; retain diagnostics and source snapshot.

outcomes.meaning: A declared execution budget or external interruption stops processing before the task finishes.
outcomes.completion_effect: Return INCOMPLETE, preserve every input item and any completed derivation trace, and report the interruption point.

scope_policies.policy: Exact record type, stable ID, and version where versioned; labels never establish identity.
Same-context rules require the same exact contextRef. Missing required context is UNRESOLVED; context kind alone is insufficient.
Preserve exact commitment and attributedToRef. ATTRIBUTED requires a resolvable attributedToRef. No cross-speaker combination.
Preserve exact negation operators, polarity, and scope. No negation removal or introduction.
Preserve exact modal operator, force, scope, and operands. No modal strengthening or weakening.
Preserve quantifier type, variable identity, restrictor, body, and nesting.
Preserve temporal relation direction, operand roles, tense, and temporal scope.
Preserve exact role-to-filler pairings and declared order.
Resolve exact definition ID and version only; zero matches is UNRESOLVED and multiple candidates are AMBIGUOUS.

constraint_semantics.meaning: All occurrences of one variable bind to the same value type and exact identity; labels are never substituted.
A reference resolves to an existing target of the exact declared record type. A wrong target type is invalid input; a dangling target is unresolved.
The constructor/operator token must match exactly; no aliases or lexical approximations are applied.
Directed operator roles and operands must match their declared positions exactly; a conditional is never reversed.
The premise must satisfy the named rule eligibility policy. UNKNOWN remains unknown; DISPUTED remains conflicting; missing status is unresolved.
Context identity is exact by typed context reference, not by context label or kind alone.
A conclusion retains the exact input context reference; no automatic transfer to WORLD or another context is allowed.
Commitment, attributed referent, and attribution scope are preserved exactly across the rule application.
Negation, polarity, and their operator scope are preserved exactly; no positive/negative conversion is implicit.
Modal operator, force, scope, and operand identity are preserved exactly; possible is not actual and necessity is not possibility.
Quantifier type, bound-variable identity, restrictor, body, and scope nesting remain exact and ordered.
Temporal relation direction and source/target event references remain exact; BEFORE(A,B) does not imply BEFORE(B,A).
Role names and their argument/filler positions remain paired in declared order; no positional swap or role coercion is permitted.
Definition grounding requires exact registered identity and version. A label-only match is ambiguous, not a resolution.
The exact named domain must be explicitly declared closed under a task-scoped policy; no global closure is inferred.
The named domain snapshot must be demonstrably complete for the queried predicate and scope; unknown or partial completeness cannot license negation.
Absence is evaluated only within the exact named, closed, complete domain snapshot and the queried predicate/entity scope.
A required task assumption must be explicitly present and reference the exact domain/policy it governs.
Every required premise must be present as a valid typed record. An absent match is not negation; a dangling reference is unresolved.

conflict_policy.on_conflict: Return CONFLICTING; preserve every conflicting assertion/evidence record and its provenance.
conflict_policy.rule_eligibility: A premise marked DISPUTED or participating in an unresolved same-scope conflict is ineligible unless a future separately versioned rule explicitly defines conflict-aware reasoning.

closed_world_requires: domain completeness established for predicate and scope
absence verified within that exact domain snapshot

determinism_policy.duplicate_conclusion_identity: Retain every distinct derivation; deduplicate only the semantic conclusion identity in the result projection.
determinism_policy.timestamps_and_runtime_ids: Non-semantic metadata only; excluded from semantic equality only when explicitly declared by the benchmark.
determinism_policy.recursion: No recursive rule application or inferred-premise chaining in USG-RULE/1.0.0.

resource_policy.budgets_apply_to: Execution work only; never to semantic graph size, operand count, meaning count, or required preservation.
resource_policy.safe_interruption_points: Between complete premise matches, complete constraint evaluations, or complete rule applications.
resource_policy.on_interruption: Return RESOURCE_INTERRUPTED and task completion INCOMPLETE; preserve all input IDs, completed derivations, diagnostics, and pending-work metadata.
